properties._html:
Texas City #6 fuel spill, Texas City, Galveston Bay

2011-08-19
At 2335 hour on Friday, August 19, NOAA HDO, Bushy, received a call from USCG Galveston concerning a 50 bbl fuel transfer spill that occurred at 1753 CDT on Friday, Aug 19, 2011 at a Texas City dock.
